title: Sistema Dos Amores - Sprouse et al. 2015
credits: Sistema Dos Amores, Xpuha, Quintana Roo; surveyed December 2013 - August 2014 by Gosia Allison-Kosior, Stan Allison, Hainer Brooks, Fred Devos, Gill Ediger, Osama Gobara, Bill Koerschner, Juan Laden, Barbara Luke, Rene Ohms, Chad Pedigo, Owen Pedigo, George Sanders, Peter Sprouse, Liliana Viola; drawn by Stan Allison, Fred Devos, Osama Gobara and Peter Sprouse (AMCS Activities Newsletter 38, p. 51, 2015; Quest v. 16 no. 3, p. 21, 2015)
sistemaWhy: X-pu Ha: the sistema the database files this map's exploration under (2013-2014 Dos Amores survey, 2014-03-26 Ventana Secreto survey). Whether Dos Amores belongs to the 1999 Mafia Maps Sistema X-pu Ha is not shown on the map.
wetDry: Mixed: about 40% of the plan's area is water (pale blue pools and lakes, a darker blue 16 m deep flooded passage that joins the Imix and Xibalba halves - the dive that makes this one system - and sumps marked 'sifon?'/'sump' at the passage ends); the rest is dry breakdown floor around the two entrances. Kept as a mixed system with a real dive; the user may drop it like Pool Tunich.

Blue fills: water (pale: pools and lakes; darker: the deep flooded passage and the sumps). Fill-only blue shapes off the passages, with a leader, are cross-sections.

symbols.why: Vector map: the labels are real PDF text (page.get_text), positions in PDF points. build_layer.py doesn't read symbols yet. No depth numbers on the plan (only 'Profundidad 16 m' in the title), no ceiling heights, no bones (no legend, no bone icon or word), no flow arrows. The small black triangles are stalagmites.

unverified: No position for any part of this cave: neither entrance (Imix, Xibalba) is in the database or OpenStreetMap, the sistema X-pu Ha has no position, and no placed map overlaps it. The single control point below is a NOMINAL anchor (the OpenStreetMap 'XPuha' node, 20.47367 N, 87.25703 W) only so the pipeline can run: the geometry is NOT on the ground. To fix: a field GPS of Entrada Imix and Entrada Xibalba (about 245 m apart on the map, Xibalba SE of Imix).
